why: State cycle 3 (docs/v3/cycles/state-3.md). A v3 `DataTable` over a query the page store filtered to nothing reads "No rows yet" (`core/messages/table.ts:79`) while the filter pills show an active search: the table's filtered-empty (the no-matches sentence and Clear filters, `table/contract.ts:161-166`) knows only its own column filters, so the app writes `empty: { cause, action }` with its own reset (P2 state-3.3, `.evidence/cycle-state-3/explore-empty.log`, `apps/playground/src/cycle/state-3/OrdersPage.tsx:104-110`); `ChartCard` already takes `empty.filtered` for the same case. And a `ViewTabs` switched back to its default writes `?view=table` into the URL, while a range picked back to its default drops its key, so a shared link carries a default (P3 state-3.7, `actions.log` step 2).
what: A table filtered to nothing by the page store says so and offers the store's reset; a field set back to its fallback leaves the URL.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/table/use-data-table.ts, src/table/contract.ts and the table's empty part (the filtered empty)
packages/basalt-ui/src/router/controls/define.ts and its codecs (a fallback write unsets the key), only where `v3-state-3-api` did not already change it
change: (1) `useDataTable`'s `empty` takes `filtered: { reset }` as `ChartCard`'s does: with it, an empty settled result draws the shared no-matches sentence and Clear filters calling `reset`, the same frame the table draws for its own column filters; a `cause` still replaces the sentence (state-3.3). Pair it with the subset reset `v3-state-3-api` exports in the doc example. (2) A URL field's `set(fallback)` unsets its key, as a range or multi set back to its default already does, so `ViewTabs` on its default leaves the URL; a `history: 'push'` field still pushes the entry (state-3.7).
commits: fix: per change in packages/basalt-ui with its tests.
proof: make check; a test that a table with `empty.filtered` and no rows draws the no-matches sentence and calls reset from Clear filters; a test that an enum field set to its fallback leaves no key and still pushes.
acceptance: A DataTable with empty.filtered and a settled empty result draws the no-matches sentence and its Clear filters calls reset (test)
An enum URL field set back to its fallback through set() leaves no key in the URL and keeps its history lane (test)
out_of_scope: The store's subset reset itself (v3-state-3-api); changing the cycle 3 build.
